commandCenter.title: Finance Command Center
commandCenter.subtitle: Payments, receipts, prepayments, and ledger audit for Denali operators
commandCenter.tabGuidance: Manual payment = open debt on a booking. Prepayment = wallet credit before full settlement. Receipts = review member proof (portal upload). Ledger = audit journal only.
commandCenter.decisionGuideManual: Manual payment — open a pending debt when the member will pay offline / transfer; then review the receipt.
commandCenter.decisionGuidePrepayment: Prepayment — credit the booking wallet before the invoice is fully settled (partial progress toward total).
commandCenter.decisionGuideInstallment: Installments — only when a payment schedule is enabled for the workspace; splits the invoice across due dates.

overview.title: Overview
overview.triageStaysInSettings: Reconciliation triage stays under Settings — Finance only links here (no relocate without Architect).
overview.attentionEmpty: Nothing queued for attention right now.

payments.submitReceiptAdvanced: Advanced: operator receipt by file key
payments.submitReceiptHint: Members upload proof in the portal. Use Receipts to approve or reject. This form is for ops/debug only.
payments.receiptUploadHint: Select a registration above (manual payment form), then upload JPEG/PNG/PDF — file key fills automatically.
payments.listScopeHint: This list shows Manual method rows only (not online gateway payments).

receipts.reviewRoleHint: Review member-submitted proof. Open the booking link to see tour context.
receipts.previewUnavailable: Preview unavailable. Once file storage is connected, the receipt image appears here.

picker.label: Booking / registration
picker.searchPlaceholder: Search by tour title or guest name…

installments.semanticsPartial: Partial — this installment row is only partly paid toward its own amount (paidMinor < amountMinor).
installments.semanticsPrepayment: Prepayment — wallet credit on the booking (Prepayments tab); it is not the same as a partial installment.
installments.actionsDeferred: Record payment / waive / reschedule are not available yet — no stub buttons until outbox-backed APIs land.
installments.semanticsMutate: Waive (admin + reason, outbox audit) and reschedule (new due date) are available on open installment rows.
installments.partialHint: This installment is partially paid. Use Prepayments or Manual payment for money movement until installment capture ships.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.auditSubtitle: Read-only outbox journal for audit — not day-to-day payment ops.

validation.REGISTRATION_ID_INVALID: Registration ID must be a valid UUID.
validation.PAYMENT_ID_INVALID: Payment ID must be a valid UUID.
validation.AMOUNT_POSITIVE_INTEGER: Amount must be a positive integer (rials / minor units).
validation.NOTE_MAX_LENGTH: Note must be at most 2000 characters.
validation.INVOICE_TOTAL_POSITIVE: Invoice total must be a positive integer (rials / minor units).
validation.DEPOSIT_PERCENT_RANGE: Deposit percent must be between 0 and 100.
validation.REVIEW_NOTE_MAX: Review note must be at most 2000 characters.
validation.DECISION_INVALID: Decision must be approve or reject.
